description: "@navikt/aksel CLI and jscodeshift codemods: transforms, fixtures, migration registry."

# @navikt/aksel CLI and codemods

- Transforms live in `src/codemod/transforms/v<major>.0.0/<name>/<name>.ts`. Tests live in the sibling `tests/` folder.
- Every transform is registered in `src/migrations-config.ts` (`value`, `path` without extension, `description`, `ignoredExtensions`). `value` must be unique and is the public CLI name (`v8-accordion-variant`).
- Test with fixtures: `tests/<fixture>.input.js` → `tests/<fixture>.output.js`, run via `check(__dirname, { fixture, migration })` from `src/codemod/utils/check.ts`. Output is compared after Prettier, so whitespace doesn't matter.
- Reuse helpers in `src/codemod/utils/` (imports, props, JSX values, token translation) before writing new AST code.
- Fixtures (`*.input.*`, `*.output.*`) are excluded from ESLint and TypeScript. Don't "fix" them to match lint rules.
- `src/version.ts` is generated by `build`. Don't edit it.
- `tests/migrations.test.ts` checks `dist/`. Run `corepack yarn workspace @navikt/aksel build` before `test`, or new transforms fail with "transform-path" errors.
- Consumer docs (`README.md`, website) show `npx @navikt/aksel ...` on purpose. Keep them.
